Tested on QA site sv11315, build v26.45.3-34788b2, on 12 November 2026.

  • A/P Aging Summary's Vendor menu is the same menu as Inventory Value's: truck icon, "Search vendors" box, "All vendors" row, the line "All vendors are included. Pick one or more to narrow.", and tick boxes.
  • Both menus hold the same 1,124 vendors, listed A to Z in the same order.
  • Only six names that start with a symbol or an accented letter sit in other places: "#1 Diesel", "-1 Diesel", "@Home Towing", "æble", "Émile's", "Øster". The Vendor menu here puts them in the name order the PRD sets for these reports (S1-R2: "#1 Diesel", "-1 Diesel", "10 Trucking", "@Home Towing"; S1-R3: accented letters with their base letter) - the same order as the report rows (SV-12140, QA Complete). Inventory Value's menu uses its older order.
  • Correction 12 Nov: an earlier line here said the requirement does not say where such names go - wrong; PRD v11 S1-R2/S1-R3 set that order. PRD S5-R13 also says the Vendor menu is "exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter", and for these six names the order differs from Inventory Value's. Settled 12 Nov: S5-R13 spells out what is copied from Inventory Value (truck icon, "Search vendors", the search box only above 8 vendors, the rows of the menu) and says nothing about the order of the names; the only name-order rule in the PRD is S1-R2/S1-R3, which this menu follows, like the report rows (SV-12140, QA Complete). Passed stands.
